name: Vijay Raghavan
bio: Received a BTech in mechanical engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology, Madras, an MBA from McMaster University, and a PhD in computing science from the University of Alberta. He is Professor Emeritus of computer science with the Center for Advanced Computer Studies, UL Lafayette, was Director of the Center for Visual and Decision Informatics (2012–2023), and is Co-Director of the Laboratory for Internet Computing. His research interests include information retrieval and extraction, data and web mining, multimedia retrieval, data integration, and link discovery.
